dialogic.text: [center]Welcome to Dialogic, a plugin that lets you easily create stories and dialogs for your game!
This unique identifier is based on the file name. You can change it in the Reference Manager.
Text ⏎ Displays text. Can be said by a character. Can contain all kinds of bbcode, text effects or variables.
Character ⏎ Allows joining or leaving a character or updating its portrait, position, mirroring, z-index or animation.
Choice ⏎ Shows a clickable option. Should be grouped together with other choices. Contains events that are played when chosen. Can have a condition.
Condition ⏎ Allows playing the contained events only if the condition is true.
Label ⏎ Provides a point to jump to with the jump event. Can be used to split a timeline into sections.
Jump ⏎ Allows going to another timeline or jumping to a label event in this timeline.
Return ⏎ Returns to the last jump event or ends the timeline (if no jump happened before).
End ⏎ Ends the timeline early. Not required at the timeline end.
Wait ⏎ Waits a given amount of time. Can hide the textbox and be skippable.
Audio ⏎ Plays an audio file (sound effect or music) on one of the audio layers (configured in the settings).
Voice ⏎ Allows setting an audio file that will be played along the next text event.
Change Style ⏎ Changes to one of the styles configured in the style editor.
Set Variable ⏎ Changes a dialogic variable or a variable from an autoload.
Text Input ⏎ Shows a text input field and stores it to a dialogic variable.
Signal ⏎ Emits the Dialogic.signal_event signal with a given argument. You can react to this signal in your code by connecting to it.
Comment ⏎ Has no effect on gameplay, but can help organize your timeline.
Clear ⏎ Clears current state like text, background, portraits, style or audio.
